keyOmissionBehavior: Store creates a new random 32-byte key when missing. Startup/login can still succeed, but that replacement does not decrypt original active practice. A successful login is not proof of content recovery.

rollback.codeRollback: Keep the latest DB and its matching key while rolling back compatible code; this rehearsal verifies latest-DB restore only, not arbitrary old-code compatibility.
rollback.historicalDataRestore: A snapshot from before deletion does not contain the later tombstone. Offline recovery and reconciliation of subsequent deletions/current revisions are required before traffic resumes; a COMPLETE snapshot alone cannot prove that later deletion was preserved.
